# Shell walkthrough, driven by synthetic input on a 1024x768 runner (client area 1008x729).
# Coordinates are read off the screenshots: toolbox "Button" at (37,581); the 640x480 root
# Canvas spans roughly x 200-728, y 147-627.
#
# A toolbox drag is deliberately absent: on the GitHub runner any ListView item drag fail-fasts
# the app with 0xC0000409, even a bare one with no handler code of ours (see the toolbox-drag
# plan's walkthrough section), so drag-to-place needs a person at a real desktop.
shot 01-start
# Click-to-place a Button; it is selected and the property grid shows its properties.
click 37 581
click 330 420
wait 1500
shot 02-click-placed
# One Ctrl+Z removes it.
key ctrl+z
wait 1000
shot 03-undone
# Ctrl+Y puts it back.
key ctrl+y
wait 1000
shot 04-redone
# Select the canvas by clicking its empty interior: the property grid's enum rows read as names.
click 600 560
wait 1000
shot 05-canvas-selected
# Select All: place a second Button, select the canvas, Ctrl+A selects both buttons.
click 37 581
click 520 250
wait 1500
click 600 560
wait 500
key ctrl+a
wait 1000
shot 06-select-all
# Refresh: F5 rebuilds the surface; both buttons are still there, nothing selected.
key f5
wait 1500
shot 07-refreshed
# Delete: select both buttons, Delete removes both, one Ctrl+Z brings both back.
click 600 560
wait 500
key ctrl+a
wait 500
key delete
wait 1000
shot 08-deleted
key ctrl+z
wait 1000
shot 09-delete-undone
# XAML mode shows the serialized document.
click 342 711
wait 1500
shot 10-xaml-mode
# Replace the text by typing: Ctrl+A in the editor must select text, not design items.
click 460 350
key ctrl+a
type <Canvas xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Button Content="Typed" Canvas.Left="40" Canvas.Top="30"/></Canvas>
wait 500
shot 11-xaml-typed
# Back to Design: the typed button is on the surface at (40,30).
click 213 711
wait 1500
shot 12-design-from-xaml
# Selection follows a mode switch: select the typed button, switch to XAML and its start tag is
# selected in the editor; switch back and the button is selected on the surface again.
click 270 126
wait 800
click 342 711
wait 1500
shot 12a-xaml-shows-selection
click 213 711
wait 1500
shot 12b-design-keeps-selection
# Copy and paste: Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V adds a second button; Ctrl+X cuts the pasted one again.
key ctrl+c
wait 500
key ctrl+v
wait 1500
shot 12c-pasted
key ctrl+x
wait 1500
shot 12d-cut
# Save: a new document has no path, so Ctrl+S opens the Save As picker, in Documents with the
# File name box focused and holding "New1". The XAML filter adds the extension.
key ctrl+s
wait 2500
screen 13-save-dialog
type walk
key enter
wait 2000
shot 14-saved
# Close the saved (clean) tab, then open the file again.
click 426 64
wait 1000
shot 15-closed
key ctrl+o
wait 2500
screen 16-open-dialog
# Keys typed into the Open picker on the runner land unpredictably (measured over three runs:
# lost, in the address bar, or refused there as "You can't open this location"), while mouse
# input lands. So open by mouse alone: the picker starts in Documents, which lists the
# "Visual Studio 18" folder first and walk.xaml second.
dblclick 260 188
wait 2500
shot 17-opened
# Error strip, last because it moves the mode bar up ~40px: break the XAML, switch to Design,
# and the strip lists the error.
click 342 711
wait 1500
click 460 350
key ctrl+end
type <Broken
click 213 711
wait 1500
shot 18-error-strip
